+    def test_three_way_tie_spans_both_classes(self) -> None:
+        # scores [1, 2, 2, 2, 3], positives = two of the tied 2s plus the 3.
+        # 1-based ranks with averaging: 1 -> 1, the tied 2s -> (2+3+4)/3 = 3, 3 -> 5.
+        # Positive rank sum = 3 + 3 + 5 = 11; U = 11 - 3*4/2 = 5.
+        # AUROC = 5 / (3*2) = 5/6. Pairwise check: each tied pos beats benign 1 (1)
+        # and ties benign 2 (0.5); pos 3 beats both (2) -> (1.5 + 1.5 + 2)/6.
+        assert auroc([1, 2, 2, 2, 3], [False, False, True, True, True]) == pytest.approx(5 / 6)
